categories.main_business_segments: Dalian Zhiyun Automation Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main business segments: touch display module automation equipment and automotive intelligent manufacturing equipment. The company focuses on the research, design, production, and sales of complete intelligent automation equipment systems, especially in the touch display module segment, including bonding, dispensing, bending, laminating, and inspection equipment. Additionally, it provides intelligent manufacturing automation equipment for automotive powertrains such as engines, transmissions, and motors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes proprietary R&D with a strong innovation system, holding 177 patents including 39 invention patents. It develops high-precision bonding, dispensing, and inspection equipment tailored to OLED and semiconductor display technologies. Production is customer-driven, with customized design and manufacturing based on specific client requirements. The company also employs advanced technologies such as laser sintering, dynamic precision compensation, and automated assembly lines for automotive and display applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic and international display panel and module manufacturers, especially those producing OLED and LCD panels. The company serves industries such as consumer electronics (smartphones, computers, wearable devices), automotive (car displays and powertrain manufacturing), and semiconductor-related sectors. Top customers include leading display manufacturers and automotive companies like BOE, Lens Technology, and Dongfeng Honda.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with significant sales and production activities in regions such as Northeast, North China, East China, South China, Central China, and Southwest China. It also has subsidiaries and operations in Shenzhen, Wuhan, Xiaogan, and Hong Kong. The company’s products serve both domestic and international markets, with a focus on supporting China's growing display panel industry.
categories.supply_chain_position: Dalian Zhiyun Automation operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of specialized automation equipment used by downstream display panel and module producers and automotive manufacturers. It provides critical production equipment that enables assembly, testing, and manufacturing of display modules and automotive components.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on strengthening R&D innovation, particularly in OLED display module automation equipment, to enhance core technology barriers and expand production capacity. It aims to improve cost management, internal controls, and customer credit risk management. R&D projects include high-precision bonding, laser sintering, dynamic compensation modules, and automotive radar assembly lines. The company also prioritizes expanding into new application fields such as AR/VR and automotive laser radar.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized automation equipment and related technical services. The company follows an order-based production model, with revenues recognized upon customer acceptance of products. It also earns income from government subsidies, investment income, and occasional asset disposals.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the few domestic providers capable of delivering customized intelligent manufacturing solutions in the touch display module automation equipment sector. It holds a competitive position with strong technology, product quality, and customer service, competing against both domestic and international equipment manufacturers. The industry is characterized by increasing domestic substitution of imported equipment and intensified competition leading to margin pressure.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 384 million, a 19.41% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 129 million. Total assets were around RMB 889 million, with net assets of RMB 492 million. The company experienced a decline in profitability due to reduced downstream demand and increased impairment provisions. Cash flow from operations improved significantly despite the net loss. The company is mid-sized with a focus on sustainable growth through innovation and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Dalian Zhiyun Automation emphasizes its core technological advantages, including a robust patent portfolio and customized product development capabilities tailored to client-specific manufacturing processes. Its products offer high precision, automation, and integration capabilities for OLED and semiconductor display module production, as well as automotive intelligent manufacturing. The company’s strong brand reputation, comprehensive service, and close collaboration with leading panel manufacturers differentiate it in a competitive market focused on domestic substitution and advanced manufacturing solutions.
